messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: Capacity: dedicated-pool-east-2 - GPU utilization 98%, queue length 320 (threshold 50). Autoscaler failed to scale: error=quota_exceeded. Triggered at 2025-11-02T03:41:08Z
oncall_sre: ack. paging oncall. @leo you're up?
leo: I'm on it, joining bridge. Quick ask: which tenants are currently impacted?
incident-bot: Top queued tenants: AcmeHealth (reserved 12/12), BlueLeaf (reserved 8/8), and several ephemeral batch jobs. A handful of queued sessions flagged priority=low.
jessica: Autoscaler logs show: ```ERROR 2025-11-02T03:40:50Z autoscaler.go:278 quota_exceeded: request for 10 GPUs denied (project quota).``` Also seeing 403 from cloud provider on scale requests.
samir: Can we enable emergency overflow to shared pool? Policy allows overflow for enterprise with active SLA if we mark it emergency.
maria_cs: AcmeHealth PM is on the line — they report production endpoints returning 503s and tail latency >5s. They need a workaround ASAP.
leo: High level plan: 1) Evict low-priority queued jobs in the dedicated pool. 2) Temporarily route AcmeHealth traffic to hosted-priority or a legacy dedicated pool. 3) Request quota bump from cloud (likely slow). Assigning tasks below.
jessica: Eviction script ready: ```python tools/evict.py --pool dedicated-pool-east-2 --filter 'priority=low' --dry-run``` will run in 30s with real flag. I'll kick it once we confirm.
samir: Running eviction now: `python tools/evict.py --pool dedicated-pool-east-2 --filter 'priority=low' --force` — starting. Also enabling overflow route: `redwood route set acmehealth --dest hosted-priority --ttl 3600`.
leo: Eviction progress: freed 6 GPUs so far, queue dropped from 320 -> 70. BlueLeaf still at 8/8 reserved, AcmeHealth still saturated but routing in progress.
incident-bot: Metric update: utilization now 85%, queue 62. Error rate for AcmeHealth decreased 12% -> 3% in last 5m.
maria_cs: AcmeHealth confirms errors dropping, they can accept temporary hosted routing for 1 hour. Asking for ETA on permanent fix.
leo: Next actions: 1) Keep overflow route for 2 hours. 2) File cloud quota request (CLOUD-7891) for +10 GPUs, mark as urgent. 3) Patch autoscaler backoff (we're hitting provider rate limits). I'll create follow-ups in tracker.
samir: CLOUD-7891 filed, note: provider support triage estimates 6-12h best effort. I'll monitor.
jessica: Autoscaler fix: will add exponential backoff and retry, PR #4578 opened and in review. That should reduce 403s from rapid scale attempts.
leo: Thanks all. We'll keep monitoring. If utilization or queue rises again, we escalate to priority paging. Closing thread once stable for 30m and updating incident log with actions + customer communication.
incident-bot: If any new alerts arrive I'll post updates here.
